content.title: Marshawn Lynch Joins Euphoria Cast Following NFL Retirement
content.text: Published Apr 20, 2026 - 09:02 Last Update Apr 20, 2026 - 09:02 “He has this natural charisma,” another “Euphoria” actor said of Marshawn Lynch. “It’s like an innate confidence, a sense of self, and he oozes that.” Credit...Eddy Chen/HBOTV Dramas Smallest Font Largest Font Former NFL running back Marshawn Lynch is expanding his acting career by joining the cast of HBO’s "Euphoria" for its third season. Lynch, who retired from professional football in 2020, transitioned to Hollywood following a 12-season career that included a Super Bowl victory.The athlete recently conducted roughly 30 interviews over a five-hour period in Beverly Hills to promote the series, according to a report by the New York Times. The appearance marks a significant shift for a public figure previously known for his reluctance to engage with media members during his football career. When asked if he moved through the heavy rotation of press interviews quickly, Lynch offered a blunt confirmation of his efficiency. "Hell yeah," responded Marshawn Lynch, Actor. The retired athlete previously avoided media obligations, famously repeating a single phrase during a Super Bowl news conference to avoid league penalties. Since leaving the league, however, he has secured roles in the sci-fi drama "Westworld" and the comedy film "Bottoms."Science Fiction & Fantasy TV ShowsIn the upcoming season of "Euphoria," which returns following a four-year production break, Lynch portrays the henchman of a character played by Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje. The two performers reportedly established a rapport while sharing a dressing trailer during production. "He has this natural charisma," said Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Actor. "It’s like an innate confidence, a sense of self, and he oozes that."Lynch now shares the screen with lead actors Zendaya and Sydney Sweeney in the HBO series. The production features improvised scenes between Lynch and Sweeney, highlighting the former athlete's comfort in his new professional environment. 0 Like 0 Dislike 0 Funny 0 Angry 0 Sad 0 Wow
